decisions.Q-11: candidate window 2017-01..2018-08 applied as a flag only; W05 reports rows outside it
decisions.Q-04: fact_orders carries review_count only; no order-level score
decisions.eligibility: dim_customers measures in two labelled variants: all orders, and status = delivered
decisions.location: customer location kept per order in fact_orders; dim_customers has no chosen address
decisions.Q-03: item-based and payment-based totals are separate, labelled columns; never combined into one revenue
decisions.Q-16: orders without items / payments are kept; their counts are 0 and their totals missing (not 0)
decisions.D-16: max_installments ignores dq_installments_zero rows; payment totals include them

outputs.purpose: Product, category, seller and demand analysis: units sold and item-based sales per line (D-15)
outputs.grain: one order line = order_items rows identical in (order_id, product_id, seller_id, price, freight_value, shipping_limit_date)

outputs.purpose: Order-level sales, payment reconciliation, delivery/logistics, cohort and retention analysis (D-13, D-08)
Payment-method, instalment and cash-collected analysis at transaction level
Customer satisfaction analysis; review-level counts use distinct review_id (D-07, Q-04)

Person-level customer analytics: RFM inputs, cohorts, retention, historical value (D-01). Measures span the full history: do not use them as prediction features; derive time-dependent features from the fact tables with an explicit cut-off date to avoid target leakage
Product attributes, category labels (category_map) and quality flags
Calendar for time series, seasonality and forecasting
outputs.grain: one calendar day from the first to the last event date

orders + independently aggregated item, payment and review summaries (one_to_one); mismatch flag; durations
persons from fact_orders: all-order and delivered-order measures
product attributes, category labels and flags
calendar from the first to the last event date
